description.value: Bike Chameleon is a small bicycle shop in Campbell River run by operator Rob Stables, carrying Kona brand bikes and offering sales and service for all cycling needs. The shop specializes in wheel and rim repair alongside general bicycle repair, parts, and retail. A recent post noted Rob working overtime during the busy season, suggesting genuine local demand and hands-on service.

address.value: 151-H Dogwood St., Campbell River, BC V9W 6B9
